dataList.content:
我们走进一间圆形房间，四壁摆满了五颜六色的线轴和裁剪好的布料。房间正中站着一个身影，她的手臂正以精心调控的节奏一上一下地移动，缝合着什么东西。
 We emerged into a round room whose walls were lined with multicolored spools of thread and swaths of cut fabric. At the center stood a figure, her arms moving up and down as she stitched something together in a carefully regulated rhythm.

肩线垂得稍微低了点……袖口短了一寸。这位客人要改的地方可不少啊。所以，您想改什么？
 Shoulder seams hanging a touch too low... hems of the arm a span too short. Much work to be done, this one. So, what would you like to have altered?

其实我们不是来改衣服的……只是听见剪刀咔嚓咔嚓的声音，觉得值得过来看看。
 We're not here to get anything altered, actually... We just heard scissors snipping and thought it might be worth checking out.

原来是被剪断的声响引来的。可要是你们身上没什么需要缝补的地方，本就没理由来找我。
 So you were lured in by the sound of severance. But you should have had no cause to seek me, if nothing about you needs mending.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
我是安妮特，改衣师。想必你们是陌生人吧。
 I am Annette, Alterationist. And you must be strangers.

……这位没有把我们称作"顾客"。
 ... This one doesn't call us "customers."

<唔……说不定她跟百货公司其他员工不太一样？>
 <Hm... Maybe she's different from other employees of the Grand Magasin?>

我们正在购买各种衣物，以提升消费等级。你这里有衣服可以卖吗？
 We are purchasing various articles of clothing in order to raise our spending tier. Do you have any clothes for sale?

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
你也看到了，你们误打误撞走进来的这个地方，跟其他店铺完全不一样。这里不是展示成品的地方，也不卖成衣。
 As you can see, this place you've stumbled into is quite unlike the other stores. This is not a place of exhibition, nor is it a place for finalized pieces.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
这里不过是默默改衣、修补磨损之处罢了。
 This is simply where clothes are altered and what has frayed is patched up in silence.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
但这不代表我这儿的东西不实用。不如带一些耐磨耐用的布料走吧？
 That's not to say what I have here is impractical. Why not take with you some durable, fray-resistant fabric?

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
在贴身衣物护不住你的地方，它能保你周全。那些衣服利于进攻动作，但……说到防御，可就相当欠缺了。
 It will keep you safe where form-fitting garments fail you. They're useful for offensive maneuvers, but... quite lacking when it comes to defense.

<这些布料看着确实质地不错，不过……她的存货也不算多。而且那把剪刀怎么那么贵？>
 <These do look like quality fabric, but... she doesn't exactly have that big of a collection. And why's that pair of scissors so expensive?>

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
有什么需要缝补的，尽管来找我。西西弗里没有什么布料是我这双手织不出来的。
 Come see me if you need anything patched up. There is no fabric within Sisyphe that my fingers cannot weave.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
你们可能得排队等等了，我这会儿正忙着给漆黑赶制大批布料订单……
 You may have to get in line while I work on the Noirs' bulk fabric order...

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
……不过要是你们有什么零碎的活儿，我倒也不介意顺手做做。
 ... but I don't mind handling an odd job here and there, should you have any.
